answer: Each identity locks 80, claims a walnut tree, and files an ember-season citation of its ring record, signed by the prior auditor. Each epoch it cites a new ring; auditors check it on the grove ledger. A missing tree, reused ring, or forgery burns it. First 42, k-th 42+7(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,538,500 plus 80,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented walnut trees fail: one tree, one chain a season. An honest agent pays 42 once, keeps its bond.
